definitions.explanation: The movement of water, air, or other fluids. Can refer to rivers, streams, or any continuous movement.
The direction or progression of events, time, or abstract concepts.

examples.english: I walked along the flow of water.

examples.japanese: {流|なが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{泳|およ}がないで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't swim because the current is strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。

examples.english: The river current swelled from the rain, and the bridge became dangerous.
To ride the tide of the times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't follow the flow of the conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めないで→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't interrupt the flow of conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The flow of the game changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦もので→もの：10988_mono⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{十年|じゅうねん}→十年：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Time flows fast — ten years have already passed.

notes:
USAGE: {流|なが}れ is the noun form of ⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (to flow). It's used both literally (water, air) and figuratively (events, time, trends).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ (river current)
- ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}れ (passage of time)
- {流|なが}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らう→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧ (to go against the flow)
- {流|なが}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ (to go with the flow)
- {流|なが}れ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (assembly line work)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}→流れ星：05049_nagareboshi⟧ (shooting star)
- {流|なが}れ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (drifter, wanderer)
